headline: OpenAI Resumes Frontier Model Training Following Security Overhaul
summary: OpenAI has restarted training runs for its next-generation frontier AI models after completing an internal security overhaul and disclosing a vulnerability discovered in widely used third-party software.
why: OpenAI is a market leader in foundation models, and changes in its training cycles dictate competitive timelines across the generative AI sector.

impacts.name: Microsoft Corporation
impacts.why: Resumed frontier model training supports product development across Microsoft's AI partnership stack.
